newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Beef strong but seasonal weakness seen ahead. Live may also be near top.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Index up but corn called higher and little room for profit at current live and feeder ratio.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Carryover from late rally, mostly steady live calls and loins seen firming soon.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Carryover technical demand after Wednesday rally, cash up and look for bullish Cold Storage report Friday.
